name: Creamy Pork Chops with Pancetta-Thyme Gravy
why: Verified 564 cal / 38g protein / 5g total carbs (4g net) per serving, dead-center of the band. Structurally low-carb: brined pork chops seared in pancetta fat, finished in a thyme-cream pan gravy, served over mashed cauliflower (no starch base). Carries two genuine pricer-lane flags: pancetta (no board home; nearest is bacon/diced-ham) and xanthan gum (no board home) - a FEATURE for the proving run. Source is only 2 servings but the method scales linearly to 14. Confidence high on numbers (read from card).
